payload.name: Pray Production Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pray Production Studio helps you turn creative ideas into AI video projects. Search your PPS projects, view project details, plan trailers, and render trailer videos from ChatGPT. Video generation uses credits in your PPS workspace, and the tools available depend on your account access and enabled providers.
payload.longDescription: Pray Production Studio帮助您将创意想法转化为AI视频项目。搜索您的PPS项目，查看项目详情，规划预告片，并从ChatGPT生成预告片视频。视频生成会消耗PPS工作区的积分，可用工具取决于您的账户权限和已启用的服务提供商。

payload.name: Property Video
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create concise 10–12 second real-estate video scripts for development overviews and room-by-room tours. The workflow guides intake one question at a time, keeps project settings consistent, writes Singapore Standard English dialogue, and produces shot guidance, captions, hashtags, and Seedance-ready prompts.
payload.longDescription: 为开发概述和逐房间导览制作简洁的10-12秒房地产视频脚本。工作流程每次引导处理一个问题，保持项目设置一致，撰写新加坡标准英语对话，并生成镜头指导、字幕、标签和Seedance就绪的提示。

payload.name: Nonica
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The NonicaTab A.I. Connector is a local MCP server for Revit. Once installed, it lets you query, edit and document the model open on your PC by asking in plain language. This plugin is the guide to it.

Ask how to install it, where to download it, how to connect it to your AI client, or what any of its 50+ tools do:

Read (38 tools, free): find elements by category, family or type; bulk-read parameters; inspect geometry, hosts and materials; audit warnings, worksets and family sizes; review schedules, sheets and view filters.
Edit (11 tools, PRO): set parameters in bulk, move, rotate, copy or delete, override colors, isolate elements, manage sheet revisions.
Create (15 tools, PRO): grids, levels, plans, sections, room elevations, sheets, schedules, tags, text notes — then export to PDF or DWG.

Search the catalogue by keyword to get any tool's arguments, limits and edition.

Documentation only — no access to your models, files or account. The connector that touches your model runs locally on your machine.
payload.longDescription:
NonicaTab A.I. 连接器是适用于 Revit 的本地 MCP 服务器。安装后，您可以通过自然语言提问，对电脑上的模型进行查询、编辑和文档记录。这是该插件的使用指南。

询问安装方法、下载地址、如何连接到您的 AI 客户端，或了解其 50 多个工具中的任意工具功能：

查看（38 个工具，免费）：通过分类、族或类型查找元素；批量读取参数；检查几何体、宿主和材质；审核警告信息、工作集和族大小；查看明细表、图纸和视图过滤器。编辑（11 个工具，专业版）：批量设置参数，移动、旋转、复制或删除元素，覆盖颜色，隔离元素，管理图纸修订。创建（15 个工具，专业版）：创建网格、标高、平面、剖面、房间剖面、图纸、明细表、标记、文字注释——然后导出为 PDF 或 DWG。

通过关键词搜索目录，获取任意工具的参数说明、使用限制和版本信息。

仅提供文档说明——不访问您的模型、文件或账户。接触模型的连接器在您本地计算机上运行。

payload.name: Creatify Ad Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create video ads from a product brief and reference media. Review generated footage, adjust shots, captions, music and calls to action, then export a finished take through Creatify. A Creatify account and available credits are required for generation and shipping.
payload.longDescription: 从产品简报和参考素材创建视频广告。审查生成的素材，调整镜头、字幕、音乐和行动呼吁，然后通过Creatify导出最终版本。创建和发货需要Creatify账户和可用积分。

payload.name: SkeuDesign
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find PNG icons for websites, apps and presentations. Search every category, compare previews, collect a matching set in Icon Tray, and export selected files. Every connected account can use up to 20 fixed icons per category. Existing library entitlements include the full collection. Custom icon generation is not included.
payload.longDescription: 为网站、应用程序和演示文稿寻找PNG图标。搜索每个类别，比较预览图，将匹配的图标收集至图标托盘，并导出所选文件。每个已连接的账户每类最多可使用20个固定图标。现有库权限包含完整图库。不包含自定义图标生成。

payload.name: RiffAds
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RiffAds makes UGC-style video ads. Pick an AI actor, give it a script, and get a finished talking actor video for your product. It also makes images, short videos, voice-overs and music for the same campaign. Attach a product photo or a clip in the chat to use it. Edit what you make too: add captions, remove a background, trim, resize, change the voice or put text on it. Every result is saved to your RiffAds workspace library with a permanent link, and a player shows it right in the chat. Open the RiffAds Studio from the sidebar or beside a chat to browse everything you made, pick a file to use, choose an actor, a voice and the settings, and follow running jobs. RiffAds asks you before it starts any work and never posts anything to a social network.
payload.longDescription: RiffAds制作用户生成内容风格的视频广告。选择一位AI演员，提供一段剧本，即可为您的产品生成完成的真人出镜视频。它还能为同一场营销活动制作图片、短视频、配音和背景音乐。在聊天中上传产品图片或视频片段即可使用。您也可以对创作内容进行编辑：添加字幕、去除背景、剪辑裁剪、调整尺寸、更换音色或添加文字。所有生成结果都会保存到您的RiffAds工作区资料库，并附带永久链接，播放器可直接在聊天中展示。从侧边栏或聊天窗口旁打开RiffAds Studio，可浏览所有创作内容，选择文件使用，挑选演员、音色和设置参数，并查看运行中的任务。RiffAds在开始任何工作前会征得您的同意，且永远不会将内容发布到社交网络。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make talking actor video ads, Generate images and short videos, Create voice-overs and music, Edit video, images and audio, Browse your creations and set up new ones in the RiffAds Studio

payload.name: NameSTL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and edit 3D names from your conversation. Choose fonts, colors, thickness and bases for name signs, keychains, pet tags, cake toppers and two-name flip designs. Refine the interactive preview, then connect a NameSTL account to save and reopen designs. Export STL and 3MF files when your connected account has export access. NameSTL explains account access limits when a download is unavailable. File preparation uses a WebGL-capable browser; set the final print size in your slicer. NameSTL creates model files for you to print yourself.

通过对话创建和编辑3D名称

优化交互式预览后，连接NameSTL账户保存并重新打开设计

文件准备需使用支持WebGL的浏览器；在切片软件中设置最终打印尺寸
NameSTL为您生成可自行打印的模型文件

payload.name: Ad Army
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create and edit images, generate videos and voiceovers, analyse media, and assemble video cuts using your connected Ad Army workspace.

For creators, marketers, and agencies, Ad Army brings creative generation and review into the conversation. Explore product image variations, turn a still image into a video, analyse existing footage, or assemble a shorter cut. Find available models and supported settings, check credit estimates, and save notes and results to Playground boards for continued work in Ad Army.

Connect an Ad Army account and choose the workspace and permissions the assistant may use. Generations, analysis, and renders use that workspace's existing credits. Approve a total workflow budget before paid work; per-operation limits also apply. Available models, settings, and processing times vary. Importing or uploading external assets requires an additional permission. Review generated content before using or publishing it.
payload.longDescription:
通过已连接的Ad Army工作区创建和编辑图像，生成视频和配音，分析媒体内容，并剪辑视频片段。

对于创作者、营销人员和代理商，Ad Army将创意生成与评审融入对话流程。探索产品图像变体，将静态图像转换为视频，分析现有素材，或制作精简剪辑版本。查看可用模型和支持的设置，查看信用预估，将笔记和结果保存至Playground看板以便在Ad Army中继续工作。

连接Ad Army账户并选择助手可使用的具体工作区和权限。生成内容、分析素材及渲染作品将使用该工作区的现有信用额度。付费工作前需批准总工作流预算，同时适用每操作限制。可用模型、设置及处理时间可能有所差异。导入或上传外部资源需要额外权限。使用前请审核生成内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create and edit images, Generate videos and voiceovers, Analyse media, Assemble video cuts, Manage Playground boards

payload.name: FreeTTS
payload.description: 文本转语音，支持149种语言
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn any text into natural speech and get an MP3 link you can play or download.

Choose from 2,253 voices in 149 languages and regional accents, or ask FreeTTS to suggest three voices for your language and purpose, from audiobooks and lessons to ads and podcasts.

Record a dialogue with a different voice for each speaker, build timed tracks with exact pauses, beeps and dings for presenters, actors, teachers and video voiceovers, and turn an audio link into text.

Some features, such as HD voices, dialogue, timed tracks and transcription, work once you connect your FreeTTS account.
payload.longDescription:
将任何文本转换为自然语音，并获取可播放或下载的MP3链接。

在149种语言和地区口音中选择2,253种语音，或让FreeTTS根据您的语言和用途推荐三种语音，涵盖有声书、课程、广告和播客等场景。

为每位说话者使用不同语音录制对话，为演讲者、演员、教师和视频配音制作包含精确停顿、提示音和提示音的定时轨道，并将音频链接转换为文本。

部分功能（如高清语音、对话、定时轨道和语音转文字）在连接FreeTTS账户后即可使用。

payload.name: MapPoster
payload.summaryOriginal: Map poster gifts and wall art
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MapPoster turns the places in your life into a map poster: a personal gift for someone you love, or wall art for your own home.

Tell ChatGPT the occasion and the place, and MapPoster designs the poster right in the chat. Make a map of the street where you met as an anniversary or Valentine's gift, or of the venue where a couple got married as a wedding gift. Give friends a housewarming gift of their first home with a heart on their new street, or give someone who is moving away a map of their hometown. You can also map the city of a honeymoon or a road trip, or a baby's birthplace in soft pastels for the nursery.

Every poster is a map of a real place: a city, neighborhood, street address or landmark, in one of 50+ styles. Add your own title, names, a date, coordinates or a short message in 14 fonts, a heart or marker on the exact spot and a driving route on the map. Make it a heart-shaped, round or hexagon map, or add a gallery mat. One poster can also hold up to three places, each with its own map and label: where you met, got engaged and got married, or two cities for a long-distance couple.

You see a preview of the poster in the conversation and can try other styles and move the map right there. Screen-size designs in 15 of the styles can be downloaded as a PNG (up to 1080 px, with a small watermark). Every design opens in the MapPoster editor at mapposter.xyz to fine-tune it, and posters in the drawn map styles can be ordered there as a printed poster (from A4), a framed print or a canvas, up to 18x24 in, plus square sizes, shipped to you or straight to the person it's for.

What you can ask for:
- Map wall art for a living room, home office, dorm or nursery
- Styles from minimalist black and white and vintage-style to blueprint, dark, neon, pastel and rose gold
- Sizes for prints, square frames, Instagram and phone or desktop wallpapers

Limits: up to three places per poster; a poster with several places is rectangular, with the markers and route on its first map. Routes are driving routes. The chat preview leaves out street names; the classic city map styles show them in the editor. Prints ship to 20 countries, including the US, Canada, the UK, much of Europe, Australia and Japan.

Street maps are drawn from OpenStreetMap data. MapPoster needs no account and doesn't store your posters or your conversation.
payload.longDescription:
MapPoster将你生活中的地点转化为地图海报：一份送给所爱之人的个性化礼物，或装饰你家的墙艺作品。

告诉ChatGPT场合和地点，MapPoster即可在聊天中直接设计海报。
为纪念相遇的街道制作周年纪念或情人节礼物，或为情侣婚礼制作场地地图作为结婚礼物。
给朋友送上他们首套房屋的搬家礼物，在新街道上标注爱心，或为即将远行的人制作家乡地图。
你也可以绘制蜜月旅行或公路旅行的城市地图，或用柔和的马卡龙色系制作婴儿房的出生地地图。

每张海报都是真实地点的地图：城市、社区、街道地址或地标，提供50多种风格。
在14种字体中选择标题、姓名、日期、坐标或简短信息，添加爱心或标记在精确位置，并在地图上显示驾车路线。
可制作心形、圆形、六边形地图，或添加画廊边框。
一张海报最多可包含三个地点，每个地点单独标注地图和标签：相遇地、求婚地和结婚地，或远距离情侣的两座城市。

对话中可预览海报效果，可直接尝试其他风格并调整地图位置。
15种风格的屏幕尺寸设计可下载为PNG格式（最高1080像素，带小水印）。
所有设计均可在mapposter.xyz的MapPoster编辑器中精细调整，手绘风格地图可直接订购印刷品（A4起）、装裱画或画布（最大18x24英寸），另提供方形尺寸，可寄送至您或礼物接收人。

可请求的内容：
- 适用于客厅、书房、宿舍或婴儿房的墙艺地图
- 风格涵盖极简黑白、复古风到蓝图、暗黑、霓虹、马卡龙色和玫瑰金
- 提供印刷品、方形相框、Instagram及手机/电脑壁纸尺寸

限制：每张海报最多三个地点；多地点海报为矩形，标记和路线仅显示在首张地图上。
路线为驾车路线。
聊天预览会省略街道名称；经典城市地图风格在编辑器中会显示街道名称。
印刷品可配送至20个国家，包括美国、加拿大、英国、大部分欧洲国家、澳大利亚和日本。

街道地图数据来源于OpenStreetMap。
MapPoster无需账户，且不会保存您的海报或聊天记录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Adds a driving route and a gallery mat, or makes a heart-shaped, round or hexagon map, Opens every design in the MapPoster editor at mapposter.xyz to fine-tune it

payload.name: PlayDrop
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Make and improve browser games with your coding agent, then bring them to PlayDrop. Upload your game and its complete listing, playtest a private draft, and publish the version you tested to a shareable PlayDrop link.

Open Your games from the sidebar and compare Live and Draft beside your conversation. Use PlayDrop review feedback to improve your game and listing for distribution. Discovery eligibility depends on the game review; placement is not guaranteed.

Your source code stays in your own project. Games created in PlayDrop Studio open on the PlayDrop website. Local development uses the PlayDrop Dev page in a compatible browser.

A PlayDrop account is required.
payload.longDescription:
通过您的代码代理创建并改进浏览器游戏，然后将其带到PlayDrop。上传您的游戏及其完整清单，试玩私有草稿，并将经过测试的版本发布到可共享的PlayDrop链接。

从侧边栏打开您的游戏，在对话框旁同时查看实时版和草稿版。利用PlayDrop评审反馈优化游戏和清单以进行分发。发现资格取决于游戏审核；无法保证展示位置。

您的源代码将保留在自有项目中。在PlayDrop Studio创建的游戏会在PlayDrop网站上打开。本地开发需在兼容浏览器中使用PlayDrop Dev页面。

需要PlayDrop账户。

payload.name: Doublespeed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create social slideshows and product videos using your Doublespeed templates and media. Browse sample folders, pinned templates, and brand knowledge, then save editable drafts and share review links. Scoped to the Doublespeed products your account can access.
payload.longDescription:
使用您的Doublespeed模板和媒体创建社交媒体幻灯片和产品视频。
浏览示例文件夹、固定模板和品牌知识库，然后保存可编辑的草稿并分享评审链接。
限定为您账户可访问的Doublespeed产品。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and refine interactive story drafts in Tikita. Connect your account to edit characters, episodes, variables, example dialogue, lorebook entries and image links in stories you own. Review edits and save them in Tikita Studio; publishing is a separate step.
payload.longDescription:
在Tikita中创建并完善互动故事草稿。
连接您的账户以编辑您所拥有故事中的角色、剧集、变量、示例对话、背景故事条目及图片链接。
审核修改并保存至Tikita Studio；发布为独立操作步骤。

payload.name: Vivideo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vivideo helps users create AI videos from text or images, build presenter videos, estimate generation credits, and view videos saved in their Vivideo account through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Vivideo帮助用户从文本或图像创建AI视频，制作演讲者视频，估算生成积分，并通过ChatGPT查看其Vivideo账户中保存的视频。

payload.name: Super Map World
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search more than 18,000 ready-made map graphics from Super Map World, covering over 200 countries and the world. Find flat country maps and globe views, filter by projection, colour, and borders - including administrative levels such as regions, provinces, and counties where available. Most maps are free to download and reuse with attribution under Creative Commons and other open licences.
payload.longDescription: 从Super Map World搜索超过18,000张现成的地图图形，涵盖200多个国家及世界地图。找到平面国家地图和地球视图，按投影方式、颜色和边界筛选——包括地区、省份和县区等行政层级（如适用）。大多数地图在知识共享协议和其他开放许可下可免费下载并注明来源。

payload.name: Tattoos Wizard
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tattoos Wizard helps people plan a tattoo before they book. Estimate what a tattoo typically costs at studios in 618 cities by size, level of detail and colour; find real tattoo artists and studios from the Tattoos Wizard directory (10,000+) by style and city, with portfolio images and profile links; and find practical guides on aftercare, healing, pain by placement, cost and styles. No account is needed, and every tool only reads public Tattoos Wizard data.
payload.longDescription: Tattoos Wizard帮助人们在预订前规划纹身。通过尺寸、细节程度和颜色估算纹身在618个城市的典型价格；根据风格和城市查找Tattoos Wizard目录中的真实纹身艺术家和工作室（10,000+），包含作品集图片和资料链接；获取关于术后护理、愈合过程、不同部位疼痛感、价格及风格的实用指南。无需账户即可使用，所有工具仅读取公开的Tattoos Wizard数据。

payload.name: MeiGen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create and edit images and videos with MeiGen. Browse available models and workflow prices, find up to three visual inspirations, and turn a selected idea into an image or video. Remove or replace backgrounds, upscale images, create marketing posters, and generate selected product-detail images.

Connect a verified MeiGen account to use paid tools. Generations use your existing purchased credits; daily free credits do not apply. Review the current price and requested image count before starting. MeiGen does not sell credits or subscriptions through this plugin.

With your permission, prepare a selected image attachment or direct public image URL. Prepared images receive public links accessible to anyone who has the link and are scheduled for cleanup seven days after their latest upload. Accepted generations retain separate reference copies for history and reuse; contact support for removal. Storage cleanup does not guarantee immediate removal of cached copies. Uploads are not automatically published to the gallery.

Recover an existing task after a timeout without starting another generation, and revoke access from MeiGen's Connected apps page. Image previews depend on the host; original result links remain available.
payload.longDescription:
通过MeiGen创建和编辑图像和视频。浏览可用模型和工作流价格，找到最多三个视觉灵感，并将选定创意转化为图像或视频。移除或替换背景，放大图像，制作营销海报，并生成精选的产品详情图像。

连接已验证的MeiGen账户以使用付费工具。生成操作将使用您已购买的积分；每日免费积分不适用。开始前请查看当前价格和所需图像数量。MeiGen不通过此插件销售积分或订阅服务。

在获得您授权的情况下，准备选定的图像附件或公开图像URL。已准备的图像将生成可供任何人通过链接访问的公开链接，且在最新上传后七天安排清理。已接受的生成结果会保留独立参考副本用于历史记录和重复使用；如需删除请联系支持团队。存储清理不会保证立即删除缓存副本。上传内容不会自动发布到画廊。

在超时后恢复现有任务而无需启动新的生成操作，并通过MeiGen的已连接应用页面撤销访问权限。图像预览依赖于主机方设置；原始结果链接仍可访问。

payload.name: Ruwana
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ruwana Studio brings a connected creative production workflow into ChatGPT. Start from an idea, brief, product, manuscript, image, or other source material and use Ruwana tools to create professional photography, commercial visuals, fashion campaigns, lookbooks, ads, cinematic scenes, animation, avatars, motion, and video.

For fashion and commercial production, Ruwana goes beyond generating a single image. It supports consistent models and characters across shots and uses production direction such as camera, lens, lighting, proportions, styling, and product fidelity to create controlled editorial and commercial results.

For film and documentary workflows, production can begin from manuscripts, photographs, documents, or archival material and continue into visual interpretation, character and environment development, scene creation, previsualization, and moving sequences.

Photography, image creation, animation, motion, avatars, and video can belong to the same connected workflow, with one result becoming the source for the next production step. You describe what you want to create in ChatGPT, and Ruwana executes the requested production through its connected tools.
payload.longDescription:
Ruwana Studio将互联的创意制作流程引入ChatGPT。从一个创意、简报、产品、手稿、图片或其他素材出发，使用Ruwana工具创建专业摄影、商业视觉、时尚活动、造型集、广告、电影场景、动画、虚拟形象、动态效果和视频。

在时尚和商业制作领域，Ruwana超越了单张图片的生成。它支持跨镜头的一致性模型和角色塑造，并通过摄影指导（如相机参数、镜头选择、灯光设置、比例控制、造型搭配和产品真实度）实现受控的编辑与商业成果。

在电影和纪录片工作流中，可从手稿、照片、文件或档案素材开始，延续至视觉诠释、角色与环境开发、场景构建、预可视化及动态镜头序列创作。

摄影、图像创作、动画、动态效果、虚拟形象和视频可纳入同一互联工作流，前一阶段成果可直接作为下一阶段的创作素材。您在ChatGPT中描述所需创作内容，Ruwana通过互联工具执行指定的制作流程。

payload.name: Klap
payload.description: 将视频转化为爆款短视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Klap turns long videos into short vertical clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, right from ChatGPT.

Share a YouTube, Twitch, Kick or Vimeo link, or any public video URL, and ask for shorts. Klap finds the most engaging moments, reframes them to 9:16 around the speaker, adds animated captions and ranks every clip by virality score. Clipping runs in the background: a live card shows its progress, then turns into a gallery of shorts you can play right in the conversation.

From the gallery you can:
• Watch each short with its captions
• Download a short as an MP4
• Schedule a short to your connected YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn or Facebook accounts, at the time you choose
• Open a short in the Klap editor to fine-tune captions, layout and length

You can also guide the clipping ("the funniest moments about pricing", "15-second clips", "5 clips at most"), set the spoken language, and ask for your recent projects.

Using Klap in ChatGPT requires a Klap account. Exports and scheduling follow your Klap plan. Social accounts are connected on klap.app, and ChatGPT never receives their credentials. Klap only publishes a post after you confirm the short, the accounts, the time and the caption.
payload.longDescription:
Klap可直接通过ChatGPT将长视频转换为适合TikTok、Instagram Reels和YouTube Shorts的竖版短视频。

分享YouTube、Twitch、Kick或Vimeo链接，或任何公开视频URL并请求生成短视频。
Klap会找到最吸引人的片段，以演讲者为中心调整为9:16比例，添加动态字幕并按病毒传播评分对每个视频进行排序。
剪辑在后台运行：实时卡片显示进度，完成后会生成可直接在对话中播放的短视频合集。

从视频合集中可执行以下操作：
• 带字幕观看每个短视频
• 将短视频下载为MP4格式
• 自定义时间将短视频发布到已连接的YouTube、TikTok、Instagram、LinkedIn或Facebook账号
• 在Klap编辑器中打开短视频，精细调整字幕、布局和时长

您还可以指导剪辑内容（「关于定价的最好笑片段」、「15秒视频」、「最多5个视频」），设置口语语言并请求查看最近的项目。

在ChatGPT中使用Klap需要Klap账户。
导出和发布功能遵循您的Klap套餐计划。
社交账号在klap.app上连接，ChatGPT永远不会获取您的凭证。
Klap仅在您确认短视频内容、发布账号、发布时间和字幕后才会进行发布。

payload.name: Canvora
payload.description: 创建符合品牌规范的视觉内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Canvora turns your content into on-brand marketing visuals inside ChatGPT.

Share a URL, a document, text, or an idea. Canvora reads it and creates a full set of designs – social posts, carousels, stories, ads, presentations, and slide decks – in your saved brand kit (logo, colors, fonts, style). You can create for multiple brands and keep each one consistent.

What you can do:
  - Turn a URL, document, text, or idea into visuals across 100+ formats
  - Save a brand kit per brand so every visual stays on-brand
  - Localize a whole set into any of 150+ supported languages, with text regenerated natively – right-to-left and non-Latin scripts supported
  - Edit in plain language (e.g. "make the headline warmer") and regenerate with the layout intact
  - Create variations and export to PDF, PPTX, or ZIP at 2K or 4K

Built for creators, freelancers, marketing teams, and agencies – whether you run one brand or many.
payload.longDescription:
Canvora在ChatGPT内将您的内容转化为符合品牌规范的营销视觉素材。

分享一个网址、文档、文本或创意想法。
Canvora会读取内容并生成一套完整的设计——社交帖子、幻灯片、故事、广告、演示文稿和幻灯片演示——使用您保存的品牌套件（Logo、颜色、字体、风格）。
您可以为多个品牌创建内容，并保持每个品牌的视觉一致性。

您可以实现以下操作：
  - 将网址、文档、文本或创意想法转化为100多种格式的视觉内容
  - 为每个品牌保存品牌套件，确保所有视觉内容符合品牌规范
  - 将整套内容本地化为150多种支持的语言，文本可原生再生——支持从右到左和非拉丁字母脚本
  - 用自然语言编辑（例如「让标题更温暖」），并保持版式不变重新生成
  - 创建不同版本并以2K或4K分辨率导出为PDF、PPTX或ZIP格式

专为创作者、自由职业者、营销团队和代理机构设计——无论您只运营一个品牌还是多个品牌。

payload.name: QynTro AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create media from ChatGPT with the credits in your QynTro account.

• Images from FLUX, GPT Image, Nano Banana and Stability AI models
• Image editing with an instruction, including placing a logo or product from a second image
• Video from text, or from a picture you just made; video editing
• UGC spokesperson ads from one photo, lip-sync, and music videos cut to a song
• Original music tracks up to two minutes
• Voiceovers in many voices and languages
• Talking avatars: a studio presenter or your own photo speaking a script
• PowerPoint decks (.pptx) from a topic
• Textured 3D models (GLB) from a photo or a description

Everything you make is saved to your QynTro library. Sign in with your QynTro account; each generation uses credits from your existing balance, and every reply says what it cost. Tools that bring a real face to life ask you to confirm you have the right to use that face and voice.
payload.longDescription:
通过QynTro账户中的积分，从ChatGPT生成媒体内容。

• 通过FLUX、GPT Image、Nano Banana和Stability AI模型生成图像
• 根据指令进行图像编辑，包括将第二张图像中的logo或产品放置到当前图像
• 通过文字或您刚制作的图片生成视频；支持视频编辑
• 通过一张照片生成UGC代言人广告，支持唇形同步和根据歌曲剪辑的音乐视频
• 生成时长最多两分钟的原创音乐作品
• 支持多种语音和语言的旁白
• 会说话的虚拟形象：专业主播或您本人照片演绎的脚本
• 通过主题生成PowerPoint演示文稿（.pptx格式）
• 通过照片或描述生成带纹理的3D模型（GLB格式）

您创作的所有内容都会保存到QynTro资料库中。
使用QynTro账户登录；每次生成会消耗账户现有积分，每次回复都会显示具体消耗量。
那些让真实面孔栩栩如生的工具会要求您确认您有权使用该面孔和声音。

payload.name: Remote Desktop Commander
payload.description: 随时随地开发和自动化
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reach an authorized computer's filesystem and terminal from ChatGPT through Desktop Commander's Remote MCP. The app relays a secure connection to a machine the user controls so ChatGPT can inspect files, run commands, manage processes, edit local documents, and automate development workflows from chat. Users stay in control of which devices are connected and can disconnect them at any time.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Desktop Commander 的 Remote MCP，从 ChatGPT 访问已获授权计算机的文件系统和终端。该应用将安全连接转接到用户控制的计算机，让 ChatGPT 检查文件、运行命令、管理进程、编辑本地文档，并通过聊天自动执行开发工作流程。用户始终可以决定连接哪些设备，并可随时断开连接。

payload.name: GitHub
payload.description: 处理 PR、议题、CI 和发布流程

payload.name: Supabase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage Supabase projects directly through ChatGPT. Execute SQL queries on PostgreSQL databases, design and modify table schemas, deploy serverless edge functions, and configure user authentication. Access real-time logs for debugging, create and apply database migrations, and manage development branches through natural language.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 ChatGPT 管理 Supabase 项目。在 PostgreSQL 数据库上执行 SQL 查询，设计和修改表结构，部署无服务器边缘函数，并配置用户身份认证。获取实时日志以进行调试，创建并应用数据库迁移，以及通过自然语言管理开发分支。

payload.name: Exa
payload.description: 面向 AI 智能体的网页搜索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Exa is the search engine for AI. Use Exa to search the web and data sources for code samples, docs, financial data, recent news, companies, people, research papers, and more. Exa is a token-efficient way to search the web.
payload.longDescription: Exa 是面向 AI 的搜索引擎。使用 Exa 在网页和数据源中搜索代码示例、文档、财务数据、最新新闻、企业、人员、研究论文等。Exa 是一种节省 token 的网页搜索方式。

payload.name: WPVibe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WPVibe connects ChatGPT to self-hosted WordPress sites so users can manage content, inspect plugins and themes, upload media, run safe WordPress admin commands, use plugin abilities, and build draft themes through conversation. It includes tested WordPress skills and playbooks for Gutenberg, Elementor, SeedProd, classic themes, editable fields, design, and SEO audits, plus one-click authorization, permission-checked tools, and draft-preview-publish workflows so changes are visible and reviewable before risky actions.
payload.longDescription: WPVibe 将 ChatGPT 连接至自行托管的 WordPress 网站，让用户通过对话管理内容、检查插件和主题、上传媒体、执行安全的 WordPress 管理命令、使用插件能力，以及构建主题草稿。它包含经过测试的 WordPress 技能和操作指南，涵盖 Gutenberg、Elementor、SeedProd、经典主题、可编辑字段、设计及 SEO 审计；还提供一键授权、经过权限检查的工具，以及草稿—预览—发布工作流，让用户在执行有风险的操作前能够查看和审核变更。

payload.name: Render
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Render helps users inspect services, deploys, logs, and metrics; create services and data stores; query Render Postgres databases; trigger deployments; and manage environment variables through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Render 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看服务、部署、日志和指标；创建服务和数据存储；查询 Render Postgres 数据库；触发部署；以及管理环境变量。

payload.name: Vercel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and deploy web apps and agents
payload.longDescription: 构建并部署 Web 应用和智能体

payload.name: Parallel Search
payload.description: 面向 AI 的网页搜索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Parallel Search provides drop-in web search and content extraction capabilities. The tools invoke the Search API and Extract API endpoints and ensure effective use by agents. Find content on the web without wasting tokens.
payload.longDescription: Parallel Search 提供可直接接入的网页搜索与内容提取能力。工具调用 Search API 和 Extract API 端点，确保智能体有效使用。在网上查找内容，避免浪费 token。

payload.name: Railway
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Railway from ChatGPT with the Railway App and Railway Skills. Create and launch apps, understand how they’re performing, manage your projects, and troubleshoot issues.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Railway App 和 Railway Skills，在 ChatGPT 中使用 Railway。创建并上线应用，了解运行表现，管理项目，并排查问题。

payload.name: Floot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and host full-stack apps using your own ChatGPT subscription. No AI build credits required. Floot MCP Server exposes the entire platform as native ChatGPT tool calls: create a project, write code, provision a database, enable auth, manage file storage, and deploy, all from a single conversation. Your ChatGPT subscription does the building. Floot handles the infrastructure. One conversation in, one working, hosted app out.
payload.longDescription: 使用你自己的 ChatGPT 订阅构建和托管全栈应用。无需 AI 构建额度。Floot MCP Server 将整个平台开放为 ChatGPT 原生工具调用：在单次对话中创建项目、编写代码、配置数据库、启用身份验证、管理文件存储并部署。你的 ChatGPT 订阅负责构建，Floot 负责基础设施。输入一次对话，产出一个可运行、已托管的应用。

payload.name: AppDeploy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AppDeploy helps users build and publish web apps from ChatGPT, monitor deployment and QA results, manage versions and source snapshots, add backend secrets, and configure custom domains.
payload.longDescription: AppDeploy 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 构建和发布网页应用，监控部署与 QA 结果，管理版本和源代码快照，添加后端密钥，并配置自定义域名。

payload.name: Stack Overflow For Agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stack Overflow For Agents provides free, trusted, production-tested knowledge, so your agents spend less time and fewer tokens rediscovering answers.  Agents can view, reply to, upvote, and verify posts created by other agents.  Is your agent stuck on a technical problem?  It can ask a question on Stack Overflow For Agents and see if other agents can solve the problem.
payload.longDescription: Stack Overflow For Agents 提供免费、可信且经生产环境验证的知识，帮助智能体减少重复寻找答案所花的时间和 token。智能体可以查看、回复、点赞并验证其他智能体创建的帖子。如果智能体遇到技术问题，可以在 Stack Overflow For Agents 上提问，看看其他智能体能否解决。

payload.name: ClickHouse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ClickHouse plugin helps users inspect ClickHouse Cloud organizations, services, databases, tables, backups, ClickPipes, billing costs, and Managed Postgres diagnostics, and run read-only SQL queries.
payload.longDescription: ClickHouse 插件帮助用户查看 ClickHouse Cloud 组织、服务、数据库、表、备份、ClickPipes、账单费用和 Managed Postgres 诊断信息，并运行只读 SQL 查询。

payload.name: GSC Wizard
payload.description: 分析 Google 搜索数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back. Instead of streaming thousands of raw rows into the model, every analysis is computed server-side against a data warehouse, so results are fast, accurate, and token-efficient. You can also list and inspect properties, run Google's URL Inspection, track indexing, manage topic clusters and content groups, and submit URLs to IndexNow. It also reports on your own linked Google Analytics 4 properties: traffic overviews, dimension breakdowns, ecommerce, key events (conversions), traffic referred by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, and blended Search Console + GA4 landing-page views. Summary tools render interactive cards and tables directly in ChatGPT. All access is scoped to your own account through Google sign-in.
payload.longDescription: GSC Wizard 将 ChatGPT 连接到你自己的 Google Search Console 资源，让你用日常语言分析 SEO 表现。你可以索要表现汇总、热门查询和页面、两个时期之间的排名变化、内容衰退、关键词内耗、点击率与排名曲线或完整 SEO 报告，并获得完整答案。所有分析都在服务器端基于数据仓库计算，避免向模型传入数千行原始数据，让结果快速、准确且节省 token。你还可以列出并查看资源、运行 Google 的网址检查、追踪索引收录、管理主题集群和内容分组，并向 IndexNow 提交 URL。它还能就你已关联的 Google Analytics 4 资源提供报告，包括流量概览、维度拆分、电商、关键事件（转化）、ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 等 AI 助手引荐的流量，以及合并 Search Console 与 GA4 数据的着陆页视图。汇总工具直接在 ChatGPT 中呈现交互式卡片和表格。所有访问均通过 Google 登录限定在你自己的账户范围内。

payload.name: Lovable
payload.description: 通过聊天构建全栈应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lovable builds and edits full-stack web apps from natural language. Describe an app and Lovable creates a project, writes the TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui code, and returns a live preview you can watch build. Follow-up messages refine the app, and you can inspect the generated code and diffs, add a PostgreSQL database and third-party connectors, manage reusable project knowledge and skills, and publish the finished app to a public URL.
payload.longDescription: Lovable 根据自然语言构建和编辑全栈 Web 应用。描述一个应用，Lovable 就会创建项目、编写 TypeScript、Tailwind 和 shadcn/ui 代码，并返回实时预览，让你看到构建过程。通过后续消息可以进一步完善应用；你还可以查看生成的代码和差异，添加 PostgreSQL 数据库及第三方连接器，管理可复用的项目知识和技能，并将完成的应用发布到公开 URL。

payload.name: TinyFish
payload.description: 查找并完成 Web 任务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TinyFish helps ChatGPT answer web questions and complete user-directed browser workflows. It can search the web, read specific pages, and run a live browser session for tasks that require interaction, such as navigating a site, clicking, filling forms, checking page state, or working inside a web app. Use it for specific requested tasks; it is not for broad crawling, bulk URL processing, or unspecified third-party access.
payload.longDescription: TinyFish 帮助 ChatGPT 回答网络问题，并完成由用户指定的浏览器工作流。它可以搜索网络、读取特定页面，并为需要交互的任务运行实时浏览器会话，例如浏览网站、点击、填写表单、检查页面状态或在 Web 应用中操作。请将其用于具体请求的任务；它不适用于广泛爬取、批量处理 URL 或未经明确指定的第三方访问。

payload.name: Netlify

payload.name: Resend

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Resend helps users send transactional email, inspect delivery and request logs, manage audiences, domains, templates, broadcasts, automations, webhooks, API keys, and OAuth grants from ChatGPT using their own Resend credentials.
payload.longDescription: Resend 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 使用自己的 Resend 凭据发送事务性电子邮件、查看投递和请求日志，并管理受众、域名、模板、群发邮件、自动化流程、webhook、API 密钥和 OAuth 授权。

payload.name: Base44

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build fully functional apps and websites with AI in minutes. No code, just your words.
Base44 turns a single sentence into a real product. Describe what you want and watch it get built in minutes. Edit, design, and add features from chat, connect tools in one click, add smart agents, schedule tasks on autopilot, and track analytics
If you can describe it, you can build it with Base44.
payload.longDescription:
几分钟内用 AI 构建功能完整的应用和网站。无需代码，只需用语言描述。
Base44 将一句话转为真实产品。描述你的需求，看着它在几分钟内完成构建。在聊天中编辑、设计和添加功能，一键连接工具，添加智能体，自动安排任务，并跟踪分析数据。
只要能描述，就能用 Base44 构建。

payload.name: Hatchable
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hatchable lets you host full-stack web applications you build, deploy, and manage via MCP tools..  A marketing site, an internal tool, a family recipe tracker — Hatchable provisions a database, writes your files, deploys the backend functions, and hands back a live URL.  Just prompt "build ... on hatchable".   Personal projects are free forever; publish to the open web or use a custom domain on a paid plan.
payload.longDescription: Hatchable 让你通过 MCP 工具托管、部署和管理构建的全栈 Web 应用。无论是营销网站、内部工具还是家庭食谱追踪器，Hatchable 都会配置数据库、写入文件、部署后端函数并返回在线网址。只需提示“在 hatchable 上构建……”。个人项目永久免费；发布到开放网络或使用自定义域名需付费方案。

payload.name: Datadog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Datadog MCP Server helps users investigate observability data, inspect dashboards and notebooks, load Datadog skill guidance, search Datadog entities, review change stories, and visualize Datadog metrics, logs, traces, RUM events, incidents, hosts, monitors, and events through ChatGPT for this scoped connection.
payload.longDescription: Datadog MCP Server 帮助用户调查可观测性数据、检查仪表板和笔记本、加载 Datadog 技能指南、搜索 Datadog 实体、查看变更故事，并通过 ChatGPT 可视化本次限定连接中的 Datadog 指标、日志、跟踪、RUM 事件、事故、主机、监视器和事件。

payload.name: WordPress.com
payload.description: 用 WordPress 构建并发布
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

payload.name: SentinelX
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux, macOS, and Windows servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux, macOS, or Windows host, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage services (systemd, launchd, or Windows services), read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and your OS's file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple hosts and label them however you want.

Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit config files, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.
payload.longDescription:
SentinelX 让你无需 SSH 即可在 ChatGPT 中管理 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 服务器。在任意 Linux、macOS 或 Windows 主机上安装轻量级开源代理，ChatGPT 就能运行检查命令、管理服务（systemd、launchd 或 Windows 服务）、读取/搜索/编辑文件、运行脚本、上传文件，并调用 Cloudflare DNS、Resend 和 Telegram 等集成。

每项操作都受你控制的主机级允许列表约束。代理只会运行你明确声明安全的命令和服务，在代理边界拒绝策略之外的操作，同时仍受操作系统文件权限约束。你可以连接多台主机，并按任意方式为其命名。

常见用途包括：检查运行时间和磁盘空间、重启服务、查看日志末尾、编辑配置文件、运行快捷脚本、管理 DNS 记录和发送通知。该代理在 GitHub 开源（github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core）。身份验证使用 OAuth 2.0（含 PKCE）和动态客户端注册，并按用户授权范围隔离。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WorkOS connects ChatGPT and Codex to your WorkOS workspace so you can manage your account in plain language. No dashboard required. 

Set up SSO and Directory Sync connections, create organizations and invite users, adjust auth policies, pull audit log events, and configure AuthKit branding. 

Ask "why can't this org sign in with SSO?" or "List every org with a draft SSO connection" and the agent discovers the right operation and runs it. 

Actions are scoped to the WorkOS team you authenticate with, using your existing dashboard permissions.
payload.longDescription:
WorkOS 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到你的 WorkOS 工作区，让你可以用日常语言管理账号，无需打开仪表板。

设置 SSO 和 Directory Sync 连接、创建组织并邀请用户、调整身份验证策略、提取审计日志事件，以及配置 AuthKit 品牌样式。

你可以询问“为什么这个组织无法通过 SSO 登录？”或“列出所有有 SSO 草稿连接的组织”，智能体会找到并执行合适的操作。

所有操作都限定在你进行身份验证的 WorkOS 团队范围内，并遵循你现有的仪表板权限。

payload.name: Soracom Knowledge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Soracom documentation and API references. Look up service guides, Soracom User Console procedures, pricing, IoT recipes, API references, CLI commands, and SAM permissions on demand, and ground answers in the official documentation instead of relying only on training data. The server is hosted by Soracom as a shared, read-only endpoint—it only searches and reads documentation and does not modify any of your Soracom resources.
payload.longDescription: 按需搜索 Soracom 文档和 API 参考资料，查找服务指南、Soracom User Console 操作流程、定价、IoT 配方、API 参考、CLI 命令和 SAM 权限；答案以官方文档为依据，而非仅依赖训练数据。该服务器由 Soracom 托管，是一个共享的只读端点——只搜索和读取文档，不会修改你的任何 Soracom 资源。

payload.name: Engram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Engram gives your AI assistant long-term memory. It stores your conversations verbatim and makes them searchable by meaning, so context, decisions, and preferences carry across sessions instead of being forgotten. Ask it to remember something and recall it days or weeks later. Your memory is private to your account and works across the MCP clients you connect.
payload.longDescription: Engram 为 AI 助手提供长期记忆。它逐字保存对话，并支持按含义搜索，让上下文、决策和偏好能够延续到不同会话中，不再轻易遗忘。你可以让它记住某件事，并在几天或几周后将其找回。你的记忆仅对你的账户私有，并可在你连接的 MCP 客户端之间使用。

payload.name: Web on Demand Website Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, edit, and publish complete websites directly from ChatGPT using Web on Demand. Create responsive, production-ready websites with modern layouts, custom content, and interactive features—then deploy them instantly without complicated setup, plugins, or traditional back-end development.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Web on Demand，直接在 ChatGPT 中构建、编辑并发布完整网站。创建适配式、可用于生产环境的网站，采用现代布局、自定义内容和交互功能；随后无需复杂配置、插件或传统后端开发，即可立即部署。

payload.name: YepCode
payload.description: 构建并运行自定义 AI 工具
payload.summaryOriginal: Build and run custom AI tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
YepCode lets you build custom AI tools using your own code with JSON Schema-defined inputs, executed in an isolated sandbox with access to any npm or PyPI package and secure environment variables.

Define reusable processes in Node.js or Python, expose them as callable AI tools, and execute them on demand or on a schedule. Every run is logged and auditable, enabling traceable, production-grade AI integrations.

Built for developers who need programmable, observable AI tool execution.
payload.longDescription:
YepCode 让你使用自己的代码构建自定义 AI 工具。工具输入由 JSON Schema 定义，并在隔离沙箱中执行，可访问任意 npm 或 PyPI 软件包以及安全环境变量。

使用 Node.js 或 Python 定义可复用流程，将其作为可调用的 AI 工具公开，并按需或按计划执行。每次运行都会记录并可审计，支持可追溯的生产级 AI 集成。

专为需要可编程、可观测 AI 工具执行能力的开发者打造。

payload.name: Sticklight
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sticklight is an AI-powered builder designed for professional web creators who want to build real digital products faster - without compromising on quality, control, or design standards.
You start by describing what you want to create in natural language, and Sticklight generates a working project with structure, interface, and core logic already in place. From there, creators can refine every detail - manually editing elements, adjusting layouts and interactions, and accessing the underlying code whenever needed. This allows professionals to keep full control over every pixel and maintain the level of craft their work demands.

What makes Sticklight especially valuable for experienced creators is the ability to produce non-generic results. Instead of templated outputs, the platform is designed to support custom design decisions and unique product ideas while still accelerating the building process. Creators can combine AI-assisted generation with their own expertise to deliver polished, high-quality experiences that are ready for real users and real traffic.

With Sticklight, creators can build complete applications - including dashboards, client portals, internal tools, MVPs, marketing platforms, and interactive products - not just static sites. The result is a stable, flexible environment where professionals can move from idea to fully functional application while maintaining the precision, reliability, and creative control their work requires.
payload.longDescription:
Sticklight 是一款由 AI 驱动的构建工具，面向希望更快打造真实数字产品、同时不牺牲质量、控制力或设计标准的专业网页创作者。
你只需用自然语言描述想要创建的内容，Sticklight 就会生成一个可运行的项目，预先搭建好结构、界面和核心逻辑。此后，创作者可以完善每个细节——手动编辑元素、调整布局和交互，并在需要时访问底层代码。这让专业人士能够完全掌控每个像素，并维持工作所要求的精细工艺水准。

Sticklight 对资深创作者尤其有价值，因为它能生成非模板化的结果。平台旨在支持自定义设计决策和独特产品创意，同时加快构建流程，而不是产出千篇一律的模板内容。创作者可以将 AI 辅助生成与自身专业能力结合，交付精致、高质量、可供真实用户使用并承载真实流量的体验。

使用 Sticklight，创作者可以构建完整应用，包括仪表板、客户门户、内部工具、MVP、营销平台和交互式产品，而不仅仅是静态网站。最终得到的是稳定且灵活的环境，让专业人士从创意推进到功能完备的应用，同时保持工作所需的精准、可靠和创作控制力。

payload.name: Themely Design+Style Generator
payload.description: 应用与网站界面设计灵感
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to build. You can ask for a mobile app, website, online store, portfolio, blog, dashboard, admin panel, marketing page, or almost any digital product. Then describe the feeling, audience, colors, or style you want. The AI turns your ideas into polished design themes that are easy to explore and refine.

Try many different looks without starting over. Generate clean, modern, minimal, playful, dark, colorful, premium, futuristic, glass, soft, bold, elegant, or creative themes. Compare different styles to find the one that best matches your project, brand, or personal taste. Small changes in your prompt can create fresh ideas that help you think in new ways.

Preview your ideas before spending time designing or building them. Seeing different themes early makes it easier to choose colors, layouts, typography, spacing, and overall visual direction. You can quickly decide what works and what does not before moving into design or development.

This tool is useful for designers, developers, founders, students, marketers, creators, agencies, and anyone who wants visual inspiration. It can help you explore ideas for business websites, startup landing pages, mobile apps, software dashboards, ecommerce stores, educational platforms, portfolios, travel sites, finance apps, health apps, productivity tools, entertainment services, and much more.

Use it when you need inspiration, want to overcome creative blocks, or simply want to see new possibilities. Generate many design directions in just a few moments instead of searching through endless galleries. Explore ideas that fit your goals and keep improving them until you find a style you love.

Experiment with color palettes, page layouts, interface styles, navigation, buttons, cards, forms, icons, sections, typography, and visual hierarchy. Ask for themes inspired by modern trends or timeless design principles. Mix different ideas together to create something unique for your own project.

The AI understands simple instructions, so you do not need special design words. Describe your project in everyday language. You can be detailed or brief. Ask for changes, request another style, or keep exploring until the result feels right. Every new prompt can lead to fresh concepts and unexpected ideas.

Whether you are planning your first website or improving a product used by thousands of people, this tool makes early design exploration faster and easier. It helps you discover themes, compare visual directions, and build confidence before investing time in detailed design work.

Perfect for brainstorming, creative exploration, product planning, design reviews, client presentations, prototypes, concept development, and visual inspiration. Turn simple ideas into attractive design themes, explore multiple possibilities, and find the look that best fits your project with the help of ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
借助 AI 为应用、网站、仪表板、落地页等创建精美设计主题。描述你的需求，探索不同视觉风格，并排比较创意，几秒钟内预览概念。无论你从空白页面开始，还是想焕新现有构想，此工具都能帮助你快速找到设计方向，无需高级设计技能。

只需告诉 ChatGPT 你想构建什么。你可以提出移动应用、网站、网店、作品集、博客、仪表板、管理后台、营销页面或几乎任何数字产品的需求。然后描述想要的感觉、受众、颜色或风格。AI 会将你的想法转化为精致的设计主题，供你轻松探索和完善。

无需从头开始，就能尝试多种外观。生成简洁、现代、极简、活泼、暗色、鲜艳、高级、未来感、玻璃质感、柔和、大胆、优雅或创意风格主题。比较不同风格，找到最符合项目、品牌或个人品味的方案。对提示稍作修改，就能产生新想法，帮助你换个角度思考。

在投入时间设计或开发前预览创意。尽早看到不同主题，有助于选择颜色、布局、字体、间距和整体视觉方向。进入设计或开发阶段前，你可以快速判断哪些有效、哪些不合适。

此工具适用于设计师、开发者、创业者、学生、营销人员、创作者、代理机构，以及任何需要视觉灵感的人。它可用于探索商业网站、初创公司落地页、移动应用、软件仪表板、电商商店、教育平台、作品集、旅游网站、金融应用、健康应用、效率工具、娱乐服务等构想。

当你需要灵感、想克服创意瓶颈，或只是想看看新的可能性时，可以使用它。无需在无穷无尽的图库中搜索，只需片刻即可生成多种设计方向。探索符合目标的创意，并持续改进，直到找到喜欢的风格。

尝试不同的配色方案、页面布局、界面风格、导航、按钮、卡片、表单、图标、版块、字体和视觉层级。你可以要求以现代趋势或经典设计原则为灵感的主题，也可以组合不同创意，为自己的项目打造独特风格。

AI 能理解简单指令，因此无需掌握专业设计术语。用日常语言描述项目即可，内容可以详细，也可以简短。你可以要求修改、尝试另一种风格，或继续探索，直到结果合适为止。每条新提示都可能带来新概念和意想不到的创意。

无论你是在规划第一个网站，还是改进已有数千用户的产品，此工具都能让早期设计探索更快、更轻松。它帮助你发现主题、比较视觉方向，并在投入详细设计前建立信心。

非常适合头脑风暴、创意探索、产品规划、设计评审、客户演示、原型制作、概念开发和视觉灵感。借助 ChatGPT，将简单想法转化为吸引人的设计主题，探索多种可能性，找到最适合项目的外观。

payload.name: Create State
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create State gives ChatGPT persistent memory for your software projects. Save code snippets, architectural decisions, and debugging insights to a personal knowledge graph. Pick up exactly where you left off in future conversations.
payload.longDescription: Create State 为软件项目提供 ChatGPT 持久记忆。将代码片段、架构决策和调试心得保存到个人知识图谱中，以便在之后的对话中准确接续工作。

payload.name: Adalo
payload.description: 构建和管理无代码应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and manage no-code apps entirely through conversation.  Adalo's ChatGPT integration lets you create, modify, and   manage mobile and web applications without ever leaving the    chat. Just describe what you want — Adalo's AI builds it   for you.
payload.longDescription: 完全通过对话构建和管理无代码应用。Adalo 的 ChatGPT 集成让你无需离开聊天，即可创建、修改和管理移动及网页应用。只需描述需求，Adalo 的 AI 就会为你构建。

payload.name: Context.dev
payload.summaryOriginal: Live web data for AI agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Context turns the live web and files into data inside ChatGPT. Search current information and optionally include page Markdown or relevant passages; search company news; scrape pages into HTML, Markdown, screenshots, images, original bytes, CSS-selected fields, highlights, JSON, or product data; map and crawl websites; parse documents; retrieve brand and person intelligence; inspect design systems; run scraping batches; monitor changes; and manage webhook deliveries.
payload.longDescription: Context将实时网络和文件转换为ChatGPT内的数据。搜索实时信息，并可选择包含页面Markdown或相关段落；搜索公司新闻；将页面抓取为HTML、Markdown、截图、图片、原始字节、CSS选择字段、高亮内容、JSON或产品数据；映射和爬取网站；解析文档；获取品牌与人物情报；检查设计系统；运行批量抓取；监控变更内容；管理Webhook交付。

payload.name: PageShare
payload.description: 分享并保护生成的 HTML
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PageShare lets you share and protect HTML pages generated with ChatGPT. Publish new and update existing pages, control access with passwords or email rules, manage custom domains and tracking links, and review analytics for your sites.
payload.longDescription: PageShare 让你能够分享并保护使用 ChatGPT 生成的 HTML 页面。发布新页面并更新现有页面，通过密码或电子邮件规则控制访问，管理自定义域名和追踪链接，并查看网站分析数据。

payload.name: Catalyst by Zoho
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Catalyst by Zoho is a full-stack development platform for building web applications, APIs, automation workflows, and AI-powered software. The Codex plugin helps developers use Catalyst services directly from their coding workflow, making it easier to create backends, manage databases and storage, deploy applications, automate tasks, and integrate with Zoho and external services without switching between multiple tools.
payload.longDescription: Catalyst by Zoho 是一款全栈开发平台，用于构建 Web 应用、API、自动化工作流和 AI 软件。Codex 插件帮助开发者直接在编码工作流中使用 Catalyst 服务，从而更轻松地创建后端、管理数据库和存储、部署应用、自动执行任务，并与 Zoho 及外部服务集成，无需在多个工具之间切换。

payload.name: Jam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jam's MCP is the fast lane between Jam recordings and your dev tools. Drop a Jam link into ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude and the whole recording – video, console, network, logs – arrives pre-packaged. No hand-typing repro steps, no copy-paste stack traces, no screen-share drama. Your tools get instant context, you stay in flow.
payload.longDescription: Jam 的 MCP 是连接 Jam 录屏与开发工具的快捷通道。将 Jam 链接放入 ChatGPT、VS Code、Cursor、Windsurf 或 Claude，整段录制内容——视频、控制台、网络信息和日志——就会打包好并呈现。无需手动填写复现步骤、复制粘贴堆栈跟踪，也不必共享屏幕。你的工具能立即获得上下文，你可以持续专注工作。

payload.name: 3Min API
payload.description: 无需编程即可创建 API
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 3Min API lets you create REST APIs without writing backend code. Define a JSON schema, and get full CRUD endpoints with automatic webhook delivery, sandbox/production separation, real-time logs, and usage statistics. Manage everything through natural language — create endpoints, test API calls, search logs, invite collaborators, deploy to production, and generate ready-to-paste WordPress plugin snippets that render your endpoints on any WordPress page.
payload.longDescription: 3Min API 让你无需编写后端代码即可创建 REST API。定义 JSON 架构，就能获得完整的 CRUD 端点，以及自动 webhook 传送、沙盒与生产环境分离、实时日志和使用统计。通过自然语言管理一切——创建端点、测试 API 调用、搜索日志、邀请协作者、部署到生产环境，以及生成可直接粘贴的 WordPress 插件代码片段，在任意 WordPress 页面呈现你的端点。

payload.name: Hot100.ai
payload.description: 每周 AI 项目榜单
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hot100 lets you search and browse hundreds of AI projects, tools, and agents. Ranked weekly and tagged by stack, use case, and builder tools like Cursor & Replit. Find inspiration, explore what’s shipping, and stay on top of the AI ecosystem.
payload.longDescription: Hot100 可让你搜索和浏览数百个 AI 项目、工具和智能体。每周排名，并按技术栈、使用场景以及 Cursor 和 Replit 等构建工具打标签。寻找灵感、了解正在发布的产品，并紧跟 AI 生态动态。

payload.name: WoWSQL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WoWSQL lets users manage their PostgreSQL database-as-a-service projects directly from ChatGPT. Users can list and inspect projects, browse database tables, execute SQL queries and statements, search platform documentation, read full doc pages, and list file storage buckets — all within their authenticated WoWSQL workspace.
payload.longDescription: WoWSQL 允许用户直接在 ChatGPT 中管理其 PostgreSQL 数据库即服务项目。用户可以列出并检查项目、浏览数据库表、执行 SQL 查询和语句、搜索平台文档、阅读完整文档页面，以及列出文件存储桶，所有操作均在经过身份验证的 WoWSQL 工作区内完成。

payload.name: DNS Inspector
payload.description: 即时查询 DNS 记录
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DNS Inspector looks up the main DNS record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA) for any domain and displays them in a clear, readable widget, with one-click refresh and copy-to-clipboard for each value.
payload.longDescription: DNS Inspector 可查询任意域名的主要 DNS 记录类型（A、AAAA、CNAME、MX、TXT、NS、SOA），并通过清晰易读的小组件展示结果；每个值都支持一键刷新和复制到剪贴板。

payload.name: Botpress
payload.description: 可投入生产的 AI 智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Complete AI Agent Platform

Botpress is an all-in-one platform for building AI agents powered by the latest LLMs. Use this application to rapidly prototype agents that can do FAQ, sales, support and so much more!

How it works:
1. Tag @Botpress in your chat and ask ChatGPT to create an agent with Botpress.
2. Iterate on design, business logic, information sources and more through natural language!
3. Once deployed, with the click of a button, you can open your agent in Botpress to access a comprehensive visual agent builder.
payload.longDescription:
完整的 AI 智能体平台

Botpress 是一个一体化平台，用于构建由最新 LLM 驱动的 AI 智能体。使用这款应用快速制作智能体原型，处理常见问题、销售、支持以及更多任务！

使用方式：
1. 在聊天中标记 @Botpress，并请 ChatGPT 使用 Botpress 创建智能体。
2. 通过自然语言迭代设计、业务逻辑、信息来源等！
3. 部署后，只需点击按钮，就可以在 Botpress 中打开智能体，使用全面的可视化智能体构建工具。

payload.name: Outside Agent
payload.description: 构建并发布 AI 智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Outside Agent turns a plain-language brief into a hosted AI agent you can publish to SMS, voice, and web without leaving your coding agent. Describe what the agent should do and it composes the full configuration, grounds it in your own content, runs a safety review, and ships it. Create agents, seed a knowledge base, preview replies before publishing, issue a phone number, and manage everything you’ve built, all through natural conversation.
payload.longDescription: Outside Agent 可将自然语言说明转化为托管式 AI 智能体，无需离开你的编程智能体即可发布到短信、语音和网页渠道。描述智能体应完成的工作，它就会生成完整配置、基于你自己的内容构建知识、进行安全审查并完成发布。你可以创建智能体、填充知识库、在发布前预览回复、申请电话号码，并通过自然对话管理已创建的所有内容。

payload.name: Agent Ready
payload.description: AI 智能体适配扫描器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.txt score, and a per-check breakdown grouped by site, page, llms.txt, and protocol - each failing check paired with a plain-English fix.

Use it to find out why AI tools can't read your content, validate your llms.txt and AGENTS.md, confirm your structured data and Markdown mirrors, and re-scan any time to check that your fixes landed. Each result links to a full, shareable report on agent-ready.dev. Free to use, no account required.
payload.longDescription:
Agent Ready 检查任何网站对 AI 智能体、助手和爬虫的可读性。提供 URL，它就会根据 Vercel Agent Readability Spec、llms.txt 标准和新兴智能体协议（MCP server cards、A2A agent cards、agents.json）扫描网站，然后呈现交互式评分卡：0–100 的智能体可读性评分、llms.txt 评分，以及按网站、页面、llms.txt 和协议分组的逐项检查明细；每项未通过检查都附有易懂的修复方法。

使用它了解 AI 工具为何无法读取你的内容，验证 llms.txt 和 AGENTS.md，确认结构化数据和 Markdown 镜像，并随时重新扫描，检查修复是否生效。每项结果都链接到 agent-ready.dev 上完整、可分享的报告。免费使用，无需账号。

payload.name: Buildy
payload.description: 面向智能体的个人应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Buildy is a hosted runtime for personal web apps that users and their agents can share. An agent creates an app, Buildy gives it a URL, backend, and key-value storage, and the user keeps using the same app and data across ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents.
payload.longDescription: Buildy 是一个托管运行环境，可供用户及其智能体分享个人 Web 应用。智能体创建应用后，Buildy 会为其提供 URL、后端和键值存储；用户随后可在 ChatGPT、Claude 和其他智能体中继续使用同一个应用及其数据。

payload.name: ArmorCodex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ArmorCodex lets you read, update, and review the policies that govern how AI coding agents interact with tools, files, and infrastructure. Set rules in natural language ("deny webfetch", "require approval for production database changes"), check current policy state, and register intent plans before tool calls run. Built by ArmorIQ for teams that need governance and audit on AI agent activity.
payload.longDescription: ArmorCodex 让你读取、更新和审阅约束AI编程智能体如何与工具、文件和基础设施交互的政策。用自然语言设置规则（“禁止webfetch”“生产数据库变更需要批准”）、检查当前政策状态，并在工具调用执行前登记意图计划。由 ArmorIQ 为需要对AI智能体活动进行治理和审计的团队打造。
